items.text: QB Sam Darnold is back as the starter, not Drew Lock: he played the full Week 4 win over the Chargers (13-of-22, 168 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT).
DT Leonard Williams (ankle) practiced fully Friday and has no game status.
DE Nick Bosa (knee, calf) is out for a third straight game; FB Kyle Juszczyk, S Marques Sigle and DT James Thompson are also out.
WR Mike Evans (ribs) is off the final report after a limited Friday practice and is set to play; CB Upton Stout (shoulder) is questionable.
DE Mykel Williams (ACL rehab) was activated off PUP Saturday and taken off the injury report; he makes his season debut with Nick Bosa out.
DL Ogbo Okoronkwo re-signed to the practice squad and was elevated with TE Jack Stoll; LB Matt Judon was cut.
RB Zach Charbonnet (knee, PUP), LB Chazz Surratt (calf) and WR Irvin Charles (knee, downgraded) are out; CB Julian Neal went on IR.
CB Trevon Diggs was signed to the active roster from the practice squad Saturday, taking the place of the injured Julian Neal.
RB George Holani (ribs/knee) is questionable.

LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring), CB Cobie Durant (hamstring) and T Drew Shelton (hamstring) are inactive.
